title: KONTA architecture
summary: One Express service on Cloud Run is the only path to the ledger. The browser never touches Firestore, WhatsApp traffic arrives as HMAC-verified webhooks, and Gemini only ever produces proposals.

components.name: Web dashboard
components.tech: React SPA · Firebase Auth client SDK

components.name: KONTA API
components.note: Holds each business's ledger in memory behind a per-business lock; the Action Engine executes confirmed proposals with a fenced claim. Non-root container with a health check; drains in-flight requests on SIGTERM.

components.name: Cloud Scheduler
components.note: Calls an internal endpoint protected by a token compared in constant time; the endpoint returns 404 when no token is configured.

components.name: Firestore
components.note: Ledger writes, the audit event and the idempotency record are committed in one batch; memory is updated only after the commit succeeds.

components.name: Secret Manager
components.note: WhatsApp app secret, verify and access tokens, Gemini key and job token, read by a dedicated runtime service account.

components.name: Gemini API
components.note: Parses intent, answers business questions and transcribes voice notes. Failure falls back to deterministic parsing; output is never written to the ledger directly.

flows.label: REST with ID token + business id
send: 10 s timeout, never retried after a timeout
